description_en: Submits a request to rebuild the image of a single sandbox for a specified managed agent. Existing sessions may be interrupted. An HTTP 200 response only indicates that the request is accepted. Use the returned operationId to call GetSandboxRebuildOperation to query the overall result. Only a SUCCEEDED status indicates that the rebuild is complete. Do not automatically resubmit the rebuild request if the query times out, returns UNKNOWN, or the result is unclear
description_zh: 提交指定托管智能体的单个 Sandbox 镜像重建，已有会话可能中断。HTTP 200 仅表示请求受理，使用返回的 operationId 调用 GetSandboxRebuildOperation 查询整体结果；只有 SUCCEEDED 表示重建完成。查询超时、UNKNOWN 或结果不明时，不要自动重新提交重建
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore rebuild-sandbox --workspace-id ws-4fff1234448849b70000 --agent-id agent-3677a577b6854f8aa4da1ed98caa0000 --sandbox-id 01a1b56a-b00f-7aa3-bacf-cc9d04b00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RebuildSandbox

parameters.help_en: The service registration endpoint ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, the operation targets the runtime instance corresponding to the endpoint under the agent. If omitted, the default latest runtime identity is used. Pass the endpoint ID, not the endpoint name. You must keep this parameter consistent when querying instances, committing rebuilds, and querying nodes
parameters.help_zh: 服务接入点 ID，可选。指定时操作该智能体下接入点对应的运行实例；省略时使用默认 latest 运行身份。传入接入点 ID，而非接入点名称。查询实例、提交重建和查询任务时须保持该参数一致
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Pass the ID of the workspace to which the target agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间 ID。传入目标智能体所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The managed agent ID. The agent must belong to the specified workspace
parameters.help_zh: 托管智能体 ID。该智能体必须属于指定工作空间
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The sandbox ID. Use the instance identity returned by ListSandboxes. The sandbox must belong to the runtime scope corresponding to the specified agent and service registration endpoint
parameters.help_zh: Sandbox ID。使用 ListSandboxes 返回的实例标识，且须属于指定智能体和服务接入点对应的运行范围
parameters.name: sandbox_id

code.description_en: Task result code of this API request. A successful request returns SUCCESS. Query task result of the asynchronous task separately
code.description_zh: 本次接口请求的结果码。成功请求返回 SUCCESS；异步任务结果另行查询

data.description_en: The acceptance result of the rebuild request

incarnation.description_en: The target instance incarnation for this rebuild. A rebuild increases the incarnation. The return of this value only indicates that the request is accepted, not that the new instance is ready
incarnation.description_zh: 本次重建的目标实例代次。重建会增加代次；返回该值仅表示已受理，不代表新实例已就绪
incarnation.title_en: 本次重建的目标实例代次
incarnation.title_zh: 本次重建的目标实例代次

operationId.description_en: The initial rebuild task ID. Use the operationId returned by RebuildSandbox. Always use this ID to query the overall result subsequently. You do not need to switch to the IDs of subsequently created tasks
operationId.description_zh: 首次重建任务 ID。使用 RebuildSandbox 返回的 operationId，后续始终使用该 ID 查询整体结果，无需改用后续创建任务的 ID

sandboxId.description_en: The logical sandbox ID corresponding to this rebuild. The logical ID remains unchanged after the rebuild
sandboxId.description_zh: 本次重建对应的逻辑 Sandbox ID。重建后逻辑 ID 保持不变

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code corresponding to this API request
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次接口请求对应的 HTTP 状态码

message.description_en: The result description of this API request. This does not indicate that the asynchronous rebuild task is complete
message.description_zh: 本次接口请求的结果说明，不表示异步重建任务已完成

requestId.description_en: The request ID, used to trace this API call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次接口调用

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful. A value of true does not indicate that the sandbox rebuild is complete
success.description_zh: 本次接口请求是否成功。为 true 不代表 Sandbox 重建已完成
